```{r, general metadata}
    ][, epirr_id_without_version],
```

```{r, filter_events_per_method, eval = FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
library(UpSetR)
library(grid)
library(patchwork)

min_average_PSI <- .05
max_average_PSI <- 1 - min_average_PSI
min_average_count <- 20
min_average_tpm <- 1

# first read the samples that have been quantified
suppa_header <- readLines("suppa_analysis/tpm_expressions_filtered.tsv", n = 1)
suppa_sample_cols <- strsplit(suppa_header, "\t", TRUE)[[1]]
suppa_psi_dir <- "suppa_analysis/events_filtered"

rmats_dir <- "rmats_out"
rmats_file_ending <- ".MATS.JC.txt"

filtered_events <- sapply(as_events, function(event_type) {
  ### Read SUPPA events ----
  suppa_event_file_name <- paste0("event_", event_type)
  suppa_psi_file <-
    file.path(suppa_psi_dir, paste0(suppa_event_file_name, ".psi"))
  # stores the summed TPM expression of all transcripts involved in the event
  suppa_tpm_file <-
    file.path(suppa_psi_dir, paste0(suppa_event_file_name, ".tpm"))

  suppa_dt <-
    rbindlist(sapply(list(tpm = suppa_tpm_file, psi = suppa_psi_file), function(f) {
      dt <- fread(f)
      setnames(dt, "V1", "event_id")
      melt(
        dt,
        id.vars = "event_id",
        variable.name = "uuid",
        value.name = "value",
        variable.factor = TRUE
      )
    }, simplify = FALSE), idcol = "type")

  ### Read rMATS events ----
  rmats_file_pattern <- paste0(event_type, ".*", rmats_file_ending)
  rmats_file <-
    list.files(
      path = rmats_dir,
      pattern = rmats_file_pattern,
      recursive = TRUE,
      full.names = TRUE
    )
  # Since I have multiple files with different uuids, I have to melt them separately and then rbindlist them
  rmats_dt <- rbindlist(pbmclapply(rmats_file, function(filename) {
    dt <- fread(filename)

    if (event_type == "SE") {
      dt[, event_id := sprintf(
        "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
        GeneID,
        event_type,
        chr,
        upstreamEE,
        exonStart_0base + 1,
        exonEnd,
        downstreamES + 1,
        strand
      )]
    } else if (event_type == "RI") {
      dt[, event_id := sprintf(
        "%s;%s:%s:%s:%s-%s:%s:%s",
        GeneID,
        event_type,
        chr,
        upstreamES + 1,
        upstreamEE,
        downstreamES + 1,
        downstreamEE,
        strand
      )]
    } else if (event_type == "A3") {
      dt[, event_id := sprintf(
        "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
        GeneID,
        event_type,
        chr,
        ifelse(strand == "+", flankingEE, longExonEnd),
        ifelse(strand == "+", longExonStart_0base + 1, flankingES + 1),
        ifelse(strand == "+", flankingEE, shortEE),
        ifelse(strand == "+", shortES + 1, flankingES + 1),
        strand
      )]
    } else if (event_type == "A5") {
      dt[, event_id := sprintf(
        "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
        GeneID,
        event_type,
        chr,
        ifelse(strand == "+", longExonEnd, flankingEE),
        ifelse(strand == "+", flankingES + 1, longExonStart_0base + 1),
        ifelse(strand == "+", shortEE, flankingEE),
        ifelse(strand == "+", flankingES + 1, shortES + 1),
        strand
      )]
    } else if (event_type == "MX") {
      dt[, event_id := sprintf(
        "%s;%s:%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s-%s:%s",
        GeneID,
        event_type,
        chr,
        upstreamEE,
        `1stExonStart_0base` + 1,
        `1stExonEnd`,
        downstreamES + 1,
        upstreamEE,
        `2ndExonStart_0base` + 1,
        `2ndExonEnd`,
        downstreamES + 1,
        strand
      )]
    } else {
      stop("Not implemented yet")
    }
    # convert to long format which still has comma-separated values
    dt <- melt(dt, id.vars = c("event_id"), measure.vars = c("IJC_SAMPLE_1", "SJC_SAMPLE_1", "IncLevel1"), value.name = "value", variable.name = "type", variable.factor = TRUE)
    # add sample names, by splitting by comma and retaining the order of which they appear in the rmats input file
    uuid_vec <- bam_dt[run_name == basename(dirname(filename)), strsplit(uuid_string, ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]]
    dt[, (uuid_vec) := tstrsplit(value, ",", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
    # convert to real long format to have one row per sample
    dt <-
      melt(
        dt,
        id.vars = c("type", "event_id"),
        measure.vars = uuid_vec,
        variable.name = "uuid"
      )
  }))


  # make sure counts are non-NA
  rmats_dt[type != "IncLevel1", stopifnot(!is.na(value))]
  # rename columns
  rmats_dt[type == "IncLevel1", type := "psi"]
  rmats_dt[type != "psi", type := "count"]
  rmats_dt[, type := droplevels(type)]
  # for filtering we do not need to keep track of which count it is (inclusion or skipping)
  rmats_dt <- rmats_dt[, .(value = sum(value)), by = .(type, event_id, uuid)]
  rmats_dt[, stopifnot(sum(type == "psi") == sum(type == "count"))]
  # recreate missing combinations with NA values
  rmats_dt <- melt(dcast(rmats_dt, type + event_id ~ uuid, measure.var = "value"),
    id.vars = c("type", "event_id"),
    variable.name = "uuid",
    value.name = "value",
    variable.factor = TRUE
  )
  # fill count NAs with 0
  rmats_dt[type == "count" & is.na(value), value := 0]

  #### Merge the tables ----
  event_dt <- rbindlist(list(rmats = rmats_dt, suppa = suppa_dt), idcol = "method")
  event_dt[, method := as.factor(method)]
  event_dt[, type := factor(type, levels = c("psi", "count", "tpm"))]
  event_dt[file_metadata, on = .(uuid), c("experiment_type", "epirr_id_without_version") := .(i.experiment_type, i.epirr_id_without_version)]
  event_dt[, experiment_type := as.factor(experiment_type)]
  # remove the uuids that do not have metadata associated
  warning(sprintf("Removing samples that do not have metadata associated: %s", event_dt[is.na(experiment_type), paste(unique(uuid), collapse = ", ")]))
  event_dt <- event_dt[!is.na(experiment_type)]
  # filter based on sd right away

  # create averages per event, method, type, (experiment_type)
  average_dt <- rbind(event_dt[, .(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(method, type, event_id)],
    event_dt[, .(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(method, type, event_id, experiment_type)],
    fill = TRUE
  )
  # TODO: do this on the initial table
  # if all psi values are the same or there is only one in a group, the filter is automatically not passes
  average_dt[type == "psi" & (is.na(sd) | sd == 0), passes_filter := FALSE]
  # apply the actual filters
  average_dt[type == "psi", passes_filter := (mean >= min_average_PSI & mean <= max_average_PSI)]
  average_dt[type == "count", passes_filter := (mean >= min_average_count)]
  average_dt[type == "tpm", passes_filter := (mean >= min_average_tpm)]
  # if PSI is always NA, no mean can be computed, clearly they do not pass filter
  average_dt[is.na(passes_filter), stopifnot(type == "psi")]
  average_dt[is.na(passes_filter), passes_filter := FALSE]
  # to pass the filter, when grouped by experiment_type, all groups must pass the filter
  average_dt[!is.na(experiment_type), passes_filter := all(passes_filter), by = .(method, type, event_id)]
  average_dt[, filter_string := ifelse(passes_filter, "passes filter", "fails filter")]
  average_dt[, filter_string := factor(filter_string, levels = c("passes filter", "fails filter"))]
  average_dt[!is.na(experiment_type), event_filter :=
    # because we want it in suppa and rmats (2) with two measures each (2) and in both experiment_types (2)
    # 2 * 2 * 2
    ifelse(sum(passes_filter) == 8,
      "event passes", "event filtered"
    ), by = event_id]
  average_dt[, event_filter := factor(event_filter)]
  print(sprintf("Passed events for %s: %d", event_type, average_dt[event_filter == "event passes", uniqueN(event_id)]))

  filter_vs_passed <-
    ggplot(
      average_dt,
      aes(y = mean + 1, x = filter_string, color = experiment_type)
    ) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = yinterc),
      data = data.frame(
        yinterc = c(
          min_average_tpm + 1,
          min_average_count + 1,
          min_average_PSI + 1,
          max_average_PSI + 1,
          min_average_PSI + 1,
          max_average_PSI + 1
        ),
        type = c("tpm", "count", "psi", "psi", "psi", "psi"),
        method = c("suppa", "rmats", "suppa", "suppa", "rmats", "rmats")
      )
    ) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    stat_summary(
      fun.data = function(x) {
        c(y = 0, label = length(x))
      },
      geom = "label",
      position = position_dodge(.75)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ factor(type, levels = c("psi", "count", "tpm")) + method, scales = "free") +
    scale_y_log10()

  psi_dist_passed <-
    ggplot(
      event_dt[type == "psi" &
        event_id %in% average_dt[
          event_filter == "event passes",
          unique(event_id)
        ]],
      aes(x = method, y = value, color = experiment_type)
    ) +
    geom_violin() +
    labs(title = "all passed events") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(filter_vs_passed + psi_dist_passed + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1)))

  # # distributions:
  # print(
  #   ggplot(average_dt[type == "psi"], aes(x = mean, fill = experiment_type)) +
  #     geom_histogram(position = "dodge", binwidth = .05) +
  #     geom_vline(xintercept = c(min_average_PSI, max_average_PSI)) +
  #     labs(title = sprintf("Average PSI: %s, %f <= PSI < %f", event_type, min_average_PSI, max_average_PSI)) +
  #     facet_wrap(method ~ filter_string, scales = "free_y")
  # )
  # print(
  #   ggplot(average_dt[type != "psi"], aes(x = mean + 1, color = experiment_type)) +
  #     geom_line(aes(y = 1 - after_stat(y)), stat = "ecdf") +
  #     scale_x_log10() +
  #     geom_vline(
  #       aes(xintercept = xinterc),
  #       data = data.frame(
  #         xinterc = c(min_average_tpm + 1, min_average_count + 1),
  #         type = c("tpm", "count")
  #       )
  #     ) +
  #     labs(
  #       title = sprintf(
  #         "%s: Average Read Coverage at %d and %d for counts and TPM respectively",
  #         event_type,
  #         min_average_count,
  #         min_average_tpm
  #       )
  #     ) + facet_grid(~ type, scales = "free_y")
  # )

  # Define your cutoff grid
  min_tpm_cutoffs <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)
  min_count_cutoffs <- c(0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20)
  min_psi_cutoffs <- seq(0, 0.05, by = 0.01)

  cutoff_grid <- CJ(
    min_average_tpm = min_tpm_cutoffs,
    min_average_count = min_count_cutoffs,
    min_average_PSI = min_psi_cutoffs
  )

  # Prepare wide format tables
  # TODO: there is so SD filter in here
  rmats_average_dt <- dcast(
    average_dt[!is.na(experiment_type) &
      method == "rmats"],
    event_id + experiment_type ~ type,
    value.var = "mean"
  )

  suppa_average_dt <- dcast(
    average_dt[!is.na(experiment_type) &
      method == "suppa"],
    event_id + experiment_type ~ type,
    value.var = "mean"
  )

  # Define the filtering function
  count_overlap <- function(cutoff_row) {
    min_tpm <- cutoff_row[["min_average_tpm"]]
    min_count <- cutoff_row[["min_average_count"]]
    min_psi <- cutoff_row[["min_average_PSI"]]

    rmats_filt <- rmats_average_dt[
      (psi >= min_psi) &
        (psi <= (1 - min_psi)) & (count >= min_count),
      event_id,
      by = experiment_type
    ][duplicated(event_id), event_id]

    suppa_filt <- suppa_average_dt[
      (psi >= min_psi) &
        (psi <= (1 - min_psi)) & (tpm >= min_tpm),
      event_id,
      by = experiment_type
    ][duplicated(event_id), event_id]

    n_common <- length(intersect(rmats_filt, suppa_filt))
    return(
      data.table(
        min_average_tpm = min_tpm,
        min_average_count = min_count,
        min_average_PSI = min_psi,
        n_pass = n_common
      )
    )
  }

  # Run in parallel
  results_list <- pbmclapply(
    seq_len(nrow(cutoff_grid)),
    function(i) {
      count_overlap(cutoff_grid[i])
    }
  )

  # Combine results
  plot_dt <- rbindlist(results_list)

  print(ggplot(
    plot_dt,
    aes(
      x = min_average_PSI,
      y = n_pass,
      color = factor(min_average_count)
    )
  ) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_line() +
    labs(title = sprintf("Remaining after filtering faceted by tpm filter: %s", event_type)) +
    facet_wrap(~min_average_tpm))

  passed_event_dt <- event_dt[type == "psi" & event_id %in% average_dt[event_filter == "event passes", unique(event_id)]]
  wide_passed_event_dt <- dcast(passed_event_dt, event_id + uuid + experiment_type + epirr_id_without_version ~ method, value.var = "value")
  random_scatter <- ggplot(wide_passed_event_dt[event_id %in% na.omit(wide_passed_event_dt)[, sample(unique(event_id), 16)]], aes(x = rmats, y = suppa, color = experiment_type)) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
    geom_point() +
    facet_wrap(~event_id) +
    coord_fixed()

  cor_dt <- rbindlist(sapply(c("pearson", "spearman"), function(my_coef) na.omit(wide_passed_event_dt)[, .(correlation = cor(rmats, suppa, method = my_coef)), by = "event_id"], simplify = FALSE), idcol = "coef")
  cor_plot <- ggplot(cor_dt, aes(x = coef, y = correlation)) +
    geom_boxplot() +
    labs(title = sprintf("Correlation between RMATS and SUPPA PSI: %s", event_type))
  print(random_scatter + cor_plot + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1)))

  passed_event_dt
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

```{r, load-events}
rmats_event_dir <- "splicing_analysis/rmats"
transcript_filters <- c("transcripts", "tsl_filtered", "biotype_filtered")
id_col <- "event_id"

transcript_filter <- "biotype_filtered" # "transcripts" #
event_type <- "SE"

event_res <- sapply(transcript_filters, function(transcript_filter) {
  sapply(to_analyze # as_events
    , function(event_type) {
      print(sprintf("Loading events for %s, %s", transcript_filter, event_type))
      event_file <- file.path(rmats_event_dir, transcript_filter, paste0("event_", event_type, ".psi"))
      event_dt <- fread(event_file)
      setnames(event_dt, "V1", id_col)
      sample_cols <- intersect(rna_to_use, names(event_dt))
      # drop all columns not in id_col or rnas_to_use, not all rnas are present in the event files (CREST data), so we need to intersect with the columns that are actually there
      event_dt <- event_dt[, c(id_col, sample_cols), with = FALSE]

      # prepare the alternative/upstream/downstream regions.
      # needs some data wrangling depending on the event type but basically we just parse the SUPPA event id
      # some information only needed for SE and RI and deleted for the other types
      if (event_type == "SE") {
        event_dt[, c("event_gene", "seqnames", "e1s2", "e2s3", "strand") := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE)]
        event_dt[, c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)]
        event_dt[, c("e1", "s2", "e2", "s3") := c(
          tstrsplit(e1s2, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE),
          tstrsplit(e2s3, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)
        )]
        all_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = e1, end = s3),
            strand = strand
          )]
        upstream_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(
              start = ifelse(strand == "+", e1, e2) + 1,
              end = ifelse(strand == "+", s2, s3) - 1
            ),
            strand = strand
          )]
        downstream_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(
              start = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e1) + 1,
              end = ifelse(strand == "+", s3, s2) - 1
            ),
            strand = strand
          )]
        event_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = s2, end = e2),
            strand = strand
          )]
      } else if (event_type == "RI") {
        event_dt[, c("event_gene", "seqnames", "s1", "e1s2", "e2", "strand") := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
        event_dt[, c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)]
        event_dt[, c("e1", "s2") := tstrsplit(e1s2, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
        all_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = s1, end = e2),
            strand = strand
          )]
        upstream_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(
              start = ifelse(strand == "+", s1, s2),
              end = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e2)
            ),
            strand = strand
          )]
        downstream_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(
              start = ifelse(strand == "+", s2, s1),
              end = ifelse(strand == "+", e2, e1)
            ),
            strand = strand
          )]
        event_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = e1 + 1, end = s2 - 1),
            strand = strand
          )]
      } else if (event_type %in% c("AL", "AF")) {
        event_dt[, c(
          "event_gene",
          "seqnames",
          "s1/e1s2",
          "e1s3/e2",
          "s2/e1s3",
          "e2s3/e3",
          "strand"
        ) := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
        event_dt[, c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)]
        event_dt[ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "+", strand == "-"), start_all := as.integer(`s1/e1s2`)]
        event_dt[ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "-", strand == "+"), start_all := tstrsplit(`s1/e1s2`, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)[[1]] + 1]
        event_dt[ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "-", strand == "+"), end_all := as.integer(`e2s3/e3`)]
        event_dt[ifelse(event_type == "AF", strand == "+", strand == "-"), end_all := tstrsplit(`e2s3/e3`, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)[[2]] - 1]
        all_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = start_all, end = end_all),
            strand = strand
          )]
        upstream_gr <- NULL
        downstream_gr <- NULL
        event_gr <- NULL
      } else if (event_type %in% c("A3", "A5")) {
        event_dt[, c("event_gene", "seqnames", "e1s2/e2s3", "e1s3", "strand") := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
        event_dt[, c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)]
        event_dt[, c("e1/e2", "s2/s3") := tstrsplit(`e1s2/e2s3`,
          "-",
          fixed = TRUE,
          type.convert = TRUE
        )]
        event_dt[, c("e1", "s3") := tstrsplit(e1s3, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
        all_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = `e1/e2` + 1, end = s3 - 1),
            strand = strand
          )]
        upstream_gr <- NULL
        downstream_gr <- NULL
        event_gr <- NULL
      } else if (event_type == "MX") {
        event_dt[, c(
          "event_gene",
          "seqnames",
          "e1s2",
          "e2s4",
          "e1s3",
          "e3s4",
          "strand"
        ) := tstrsplit(get(id_col), ":", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)]
        event_dt[, c("gene_id", "Event Type") := tstrsplit(event_gene, ";", fixed = T)]
        event_dt[, start_all := tstrsplit(e1s2, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)[[1]] + 1]
        event_dt[, end_all := tstrsplit(e3s4, "-", fixed = TRUE, type.convert = TRUE)[[2]] - 1]
        all_gr <-
          event_dt[, GRanges(
            seqnames = seqnames,
            ranges = IRanges(start = start_all, end = end_all),
            strand = strand
          )]
        upstream_gr <- NULL
        downstream_gr <- NULL
        event_gr <- NULL
      } else {
        stop("unknown event")
      }
      if (event_type %in% to_analyze) {
        # show event_dt without sample_cols
        hits <- findOverlaps(event_gr)

        from <- queryHits(hits)
        to <- subjectHits(hits)

        # keep <- from != to
        # from <- from[keep]
        # to <- to[keep]

        n <- length(event_gr)
        # Build an undirected graph, get components
        g <- igraph::graph_from_edgelist(cbind(from, to), directed = FALSE)
        # Ensure isolated vertices are included
        stopifnot(igraph::vcount(g) == length(event_gr))
        # make sure that the graph has the same order as event_gr
        stopifnot(all(igraph::V(g) == unique(from)))
        # extract the components
        comp <- igraph::components(g)
        # add the cluster membership to the event_dt
        event_dt[, event_cluster := comp$membership]
        # get number of NAs per row in the sample columns
        event_dt[, n_na := rowSums(is.na(.SD)), .SDcols = sample_cols]

        # clip PSI to avoid 0/1 issues for logit
        eps <- 1e-4
        psi_clipped_dt <- event_dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) pmin(pmax(x, eps), 1 - eps)), .SDcols = sample_cols]

        # logit transform
        psi_logit_dt <- psi_clipped_dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) log(x / (1 - x)))]

        # compute variability on logit scale (robust)
        event_dt[, mad_logit := apply(psi_logit_dt, 1, mad, na.rm = TRUE)]
        event_dt[, iqr_logit := apply(psi_logit_dt, 1, IQR, na.rm = TRUE)]

        # keep sd for reference (optional, still on raw scale)
        event_dt[, sd := apply(.SD, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE), .SDcols = sample_cols]
        # get the representative of each cluster, which is the one with the lowest number of NAs, highest iqr_logit, then highest mad_logit, in that order
        event_dt[, cluster_representative := event_id == .SD[order(n_na, -mad_logit, -iqr_logit)[1], event_id], by = event_cluster]
        # note whether on autoposomes or gonosomes
        event_dt[, is_autosome := !seqnames %in% c("chrX", "chrY")]
        event_dt[, transcript_filter := transcript_filter]
        return(list(
          event_dt = event_dt[
            ,
            c("event_id", "gene_id", "seqnames", "strand", "Event Type", "transcript_filter", "event_cluster", "cluster_representative", "n_na", "iqr_logit", "mad_logit", "sd", "is_autosome", ..sample_cols)
          ],
          # dt with event info
          event_gr = event_gr,
          # gr of alternative region
          upstream_gr = upstream_gr,
          # gr of upstream region
          downstream_gr = downstream_gr,
          # gr of downstream region
          all_gr = all_gr # merged gr
        ))
      }
      list()
    },
    simplify = FALSE
  )
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

```{r, fig.width=7, fig.height=4, event-filtering}
# make one large GRanges object with all events

#       function(y) event_res[[y]][[x]]$event_dt[, table(cluster_representative, is_autosome)],
#       simplify = FALSE
#     )
#   },
#   simplify = FALSE

# stack event_dts and gr objects for SE and RI events
event_dt <- data.table()
event_gr <- GRanges()
upstream_gr <- GRanges()
downstream_gr <- GRanges()
all_gr <- GRanges()
for (transcript_filter in transcript_filters) {
  for (this_event in to_analyze) {
    this_dt <- copy(event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$event_dt)
    this_event_gr <- event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$event_gr

    # actually append the data to GRanges
    event_gr <- c(event_gr, this_event_gr)
    upstream_gr <- c(upstream_gr, event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$upstream_gr)
    downstream_gr <- c(downstream_gr, event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$downstream_gr)
    all_gr <- c(all_gr, event_res[[transcript_filter]][[this_event]]$all_gr)
    # actually append the data to data table
    event_dt <- rbind(event_dt, this_dt)
  }
}

rm(event_res)
# adjust ids to be unique indices
event_dt[, ID := seq.int(.N)]
event_dt[, `Event Type` := factor(`Event Type`, levels = to_analyze)] # make sure the order is correct
event_dt[, transcript_filter := factor(transcript_filter, levels = transcript_filters)] # make sure the order is correct
# event_dt[, table(cluster_representative, is_autosome, transcript_filter, `Event Type`)]
event_dt[cluster_representative & is_autosome, table(transcript_filter, `Event Type`)]

# include experimental events manually, to make sure models are built for this:
#  4019, 4020, 460:463, 310:314, 8201:8202, 1658, 1048:1049, 13896:13897)

# double check ids
cols_to_factor <- c("event_id", "gene_id", "seqnames", "strand")
event_dt[, (cols_to_factor) := lapply(.SD, as.factor), .SDcols = cols_to_factor]
sample_cols <- intersect(rna_to_use, names(event_dt))
```

```{r, export-sequences}
library(Biostrings)
genome_fasta <-
  "data/GCA_000001405.15_GRCh38_no_alt_analysis_set.fna.gz"
genome <- readDNAStringSet(genome_fasta) # load genome
chr_names <-
  tstrsplit(names(genome), "[ \t]+", keep = 1)[[1]] # split names by tab/space
names(genome) <- chr_names

# make new genomic ranges object from event_dt: create 5' 9mer 9 bases long. [3 bases in exon][6 bases in intron] for SE, we need to take the end here
# the 5ss of the downstream intron, i.e., the skippping ss
down5ss <- promoters(downstream_gr, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)
# the 5ss of the upstreamn intron, i.e., the including ss
up5ss <- promoters(upstream_gr, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)
# for ri, the 5ss is the 5ss of the intron itself
event5ss <- promoters(event_gr, upstream = 3, downstream = 6)

is_se <- event_dt[, `Event Type` == "SE"]
se5ss_ranges <- down5ss[is_se]
upe5ss_ranges <- up5ss[is_se]
ri5ss_ranges <- event5ss[!is_se]
ss5_indices <- order(c(which(is_se), which(!is_se)))
ss5_gr <- c(se5ss_ranges, ri5ss_ranges)[ss5_indices]
ss5up_gr <- c(upe5ss_ranges, ri5ss_ranges)[ss5_indices]


# extract actual sequences
ss5 <- genome[ss5_gr]
ss5up <- genome[ss5up_gr]
ss5[event_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss5[event_dt[, strand == "-"]])
ss5up[event_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss5up[event_dt[, strand == "-"]])
names(ss5) <- event_dt[, ID]
names(ss5up) <- event_dt[, ID]
# remove Ns, because MaxEntScan can't handle them
ss5 <-
  ss5[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss5), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
ss5up <-
  ss5up[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss5up), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
# write to file
ss5_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5ss.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss5, filepath = ss5_file)
ss5up_file <- sprintf("processed_data/5ss_up.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss5up, filepath = ss5up_file)

# make new genomic ranges object from event_dt: create 3' 23mer 23 bases long. [20 bases in the intron][3 base in the exon] for SE, we need to take the start here
up3ss <- promoters(event_gr, upstream = 20, downstream = 3)
# for the downstream 3ss, we flip the strand and use promoter on the downstream intron, because we want the 3ss of the downstream intron, which is the skipping ss for SE
down3ss <- promoters(GRanges(seqnames = seqnames(downstream_gr), ranges = ranges(downstream_gr), strand = ifelse(strand(downstream_gr) == "-", "+", "-")),
  upstream = 3, downstream = 20
)

event3ss <- promoters(downstream_gr, upstream = 20, downstream = 3)
se3ss_ranges <- up3ss[is_se]
downe3ss_ranges <- down3ss[is_se]
ri3ss_ranges <- event3ss[!is_se]
ss3_indices <- order(c(which(is_se), which(!is_se)))
ss3_gr <- c(se3ss_ranges, ri3ss_ranges)[ss3_indices]
ss3_down <- c(downe3ss_ranges, ri3ss_ranges)[ss3_indices]

# extract actual sequences
ss3 <- genome[ss3_gr]
ss3down <- genome[ss3_down]
ss3[event_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss3[event_dt[, strand == "-"]])
names(ss3) <- event_dt[, ID]
ss3down[event_dt[, strand == "-"]] <-
  reverseComplement(ss3down[event_dt[, strand == "-"]])
names(ss3down) <- event_dt[, ID]
# remove Ns, because MaxEntScan can't handle them
ss3 <-
  ss3[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss3), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
ss3down <-
  ss3down[sapply(vmatchPattern("N", ss3down), function(x) {
    length(x) == 0
  })]
# write to file
ss3_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3ss.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss3, filepath = ss3_file)
ss3down_file <- sprintf("processed_data/3ss_down.fasta")
writeXStringSet(ss3down, filepath = ss3down_file)

# clean all DNAStringSet objects to free memory
rm(genome, ss3, ss3down, ss5, ss5up)
gc()

# define the ss3 and ss5 score files
ss3_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/3scores.txt")
ss3down_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/3down_scores.txt")
ss5_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/5scores.txt")
ss5up_score_file <-
  sprintf("processed_data/5up_scores.txt")
```

```{r, add-intrinsic-features}
# load annotation
annotations <- pbmclapply(transcript_filters, function(this_transcript_filter) {
  annotation <- rtracklayer::import(sprintf("splicing_analysis/gencode.v29.%s.gtf", this_transcript_filter))
  exon_annotation <- annotation[annotation$type == "exon"]
  # adjust seqlevels
  seqlevels(event_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)
  seqlevels(upstream_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)
  seqlevels(downstream_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)
  seqlevels(all_gr) <- seqlevels(annotation)

  # regions that need direct match:
  used_exons <- event_gr[event_dt[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE", ID]]
  used_retained_introns <- all_gr[event_dt[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "RI", ID]]
  used_regions <- c(used_exons, used_retained_introns)

  hits <- findOverlaps(exon_annotation, used_regions, type = "equal")
  # TODO: not enough! the neighboring regions should be in it as well, but are not kept anymore
  # these are not used currently, but should be later, we cannot treat transcript_ids with confidence atm
  used_upstream_introns <- upstream_gr[event_dt[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE", ID]]
  used_downstream_introns <- downstream_gr[event_dt[transcript_filter == this_transcript_filter & `Event Type` == "SE", ID]]

  is_negative_strand <- as.logical(strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) == "-")
  hit_upstream_intron_starts <- fifelse(is_negative_strand, end(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) + 1, end(exon_annotation[from(hits) - 1]) + 1)
  hit_upstream_intron_ends <- fifelse(is_negative_strand, start(exon_annotation[from(hits) - 1]) - 1, start(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) - 1)
  hit_upstream_introns <- GRanges(
    seqnames = seqnames(exon_annotation[from(hits)]),
    ranges = IRanges(start = pmin(hit_upstream_intron_starts, hit_upstream_intron_ends), end = pmax(hit_upstream_intron_starts, hit_upstream_intron_ends)),
    strand = strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)])
  )
  hit_downstream_intron_starts <- fifelse(is_negative_strand, end(exon_annotation[from(hits) + 1]) + 1, end(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) + 1)
  hit_downstream_intron_ends <- fifelse(is_negative_strand, start(exon_annotation[from(hits)]) - 1, start(exon_annotation[from(hits) + 1]) - 1)
  hit_downstream_introns <- GRanges(
    seqnames = seqnames(exon_annotation[from(hits)]),
    ranges = IRanges(start = pmin(hit_downstream_intron_starts, hit_downstream_intron_ends), end = pmax(hit_downstream_intron_starts, hit_downstream_intron_ends)),
    strand = strand(exon_annotation[from(hits)])
  )

  # ex_id <- 52133 # 52130
  # # 50936262-50941105:50941209-50942031
  # hits[ex_id, ]
  # used_exons[to(hits)[ex_id]]
  # exon_annotation[c(from(hits)[ex_id] - 1, from(hits)[ex_id], from(hits)[ex_id] + 1)]

  # used_upstream_introns[to(hits)[ex_id]]
  # hit_upstream_introns[ex_id]

  # used_downstream_introns[to(hits)[ex_id]]
  # hit_downstream_introns[ex_id]

  # now check direct matches for the introns, add retained introns again as decoy, such that lengths match
  upstream_match <- hit_upstream_introns == c(used_upstream_introns, used_retained_introns)[to(hits)]
  downstream_match <- hit_downstream_introns == c(used_downstream_introns, used_retained_introns)[to(hits)]

  # hits are only valid if it is RI, or or also have upstream and downstream match, otherwise we might have the wrong transcript,
  # because the exon matches but not the splice sites/introns
  valid_hits <- (upstream_match & downstream_match) | # splice site match
    to(hits) %in% seq(length(used_exons) + 1, length(used_exons) + length(used_retained_introns)) # RI
  hit_dt <- unique(as.data.table(cbind(mcols(exon_annotation)[from(hits), c("gene_id", "transcript_id")], list(ID = to(hits)))))

  # for invalid_hits, remove the transcript_id, because we cannot be sure about the transcript, but keep the gene_id, because the exon match is correct and thus the gene should be correct
  hit_dt[!valid_hits, transcript_id := NA]
  # some not found, so this is not true anymore
  hit_dt[, stopifnot(uniqueN(ID) == length(used_regions))]

  used_transcripts <- annotation[
    annotation$type == "transcript" &
      (!is.na(annotation$transcript_id) &
        annotation$transcript_id %in% hit_dt[, transcript_id])
  ]
  used_tr_dt <- data.table(
    gene_id = used_transcripts$gene_id,
    transcript_id = used_transcripts$transcript_id,
    strand = as.factor(strand(used_transcripts)),
    tr_start = start(used_transcripts),
    tr_end = end(used_transcripts)
  )

  used_genes <- annotation[
    annotation$type == "gene" &
      (!is.na(annotation$gene_id) &
        annotation$gene_id %in% hit_dt[, gene_id])
  ]
  used_gene_dt <- data.table(
    gene_id = used_genes$gene_id,
    gene_start = start(used_genes),
    strand = as.factor(strand(used_genes)),
    gene_end = end(used_genes)
  )
  # start_end_anno <- merge(used_tr_dt, used_gene_dt)
  anno_hit_dt <- merge(hit_dt, used_gene_dt, by = "gene_id", all.x = TRUE)
  anno_hit_dt <- merge(anno_hit_dt, used_tr_dt, by = c("gene_id", "transcript_id", "strand"), all.x = TRUE)
  anno_hit_dt
}, mc.cores = length(transcript_filters))
names(annotations) <- transcript_filters
annotation_dt <- rbindlist(annotations, idcol = "anno_transcript_filter")
# Fix the ids, because they are starting from 1 for each transcript filter, we just add the minimum minus 1 to the ids of each transcript filter

by = .(`Event Type`, transcript_filter, event_cluster)
]

# get min transcript start and max transcript end for each event depending on the strand, because we want to compute the distance to TSS and TES
event_dt[, closest_tr_start := mapply(tr_starts, strand, FUN = function(starts, strand) {
  if (strand == "-") {
    min(starts)
  } else {
    max(starts)
  }
})]
event_dt[, closest_tr_end := mapply(tr_ends, strand, FUN = function(ends, strand) {
  if (strand == "-") {
    max(ends)
  } else {
    min(ends)
  }
})]

# add scores to event_dt
ss_dt <- merge(scores3, scores5, by = "ID")
event_dt[ss_dt, on = "ID", c("3ss", "3ssdown", "5ss", "5ssup") := .(i.3ss, i.3ssdown, i.5ss, i.5ssup)]


# add distance to TSS and TES
event_dt[, distance_TSS := fifelse(
  strand == "-",
  closest_tr_end - end(event_gr[ID]),
  start(event_gr[ID]) - closest_tr_start
)]
event_dt[!is.finite(distance_TSS), distance_TSS := NA]

event_dt[, distance_TES := fifelse(
  strand == "-",
  start(event_gr[ID]) - closest_tr_start,
  closest_tr_end - end(event_gr[ID])
)]
event_dt[!is.finite(distance_TES), distance_TES := NA]
identical(event_dt[is.na(distance_TSS), ID], event_dt[is.na(distance_TES), ID])

event_dt[, distance_gene_start := fifelse(
  strand == "-",
  gene_end - end(event_gr[ID]),
  start(event_gr[ID]) - gene_start
)]
event_dt[, distance_gene_end := fifelse(
  strand == "-",
  start(event_gr[ID]) - gene_start,
  gene_end - end(event_gr[ID])
)]

# check that distance to TSS and TES are correlated with distance to gene start and end, respectively
ggplot(event_dt, aes(x = distance_gene_start + 1, y = distance_TSS + 1, color = is_autosome & cluster_representative)) +

# add region_lengths
event_dt[, paste("width", "upstream_other_region", sep = ";") := width(upstream_gr)]
event_dt[, paste("width", "event_name", sep = ";") := width(event_gr)]
```

```{r, check event widths}
make_window <- function(gr, window_size = 200, fix = "start", names = NULL) {
  window <- resize(gr, width = window_size, fix = fix)
  # if we are now outside the original gr, we need to adjust the window
  window <- pintersect(window, gr)
  stopifnot(all(window$hit))
  window$hit <- NULL
  window$name <- names
  return(window)
}

five_prime_up <- make_window(upstream_gr, window_size = 200, fix = "end", names = sprintf("5up_%d", event_dt[, ID]))
five_prime_down <- make_window(event_gr, window_size = 200, fix = "start", names = sprintf("5down_%d", event_dt[, ID]))
three_prime_up <- make_window(event_gr, window_size = 200, fix = "end", names = sprintf("3up_%d", event_dt[, ID]))
three_prime_down <- make_window(downstream_gr, window_size = 200, fix = "start", names = sprintf("3down_%d", event_dt[, ID]))
```

```{r, load-ChromHMM}
library(mclust)
event_dt[,
  Variability := {
    fit <- mclust::Mclust(.SD[is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated, .(mad_logit, iqr_logit)], G = 2)
    means <- fit$parameters$mean
    class_mapping <- c("Low", "High")
    if (means[1, 1] > means[2, 1]) {
      class_mapping <- rev(class_mapping)
    }
    class_mapping[predict(fit, .SD[, .(mad_logit, iqr_logit)])$classification]
  },
  by = .(transcript_filter, `Event Type`)
]
event_dt[, table(Variability, is_autosome & cluster_representative_annotated, transcript_filter, `Event Type`)]

  five_prime_down[keep_rows_manual],
  three_prime_up[keep_rows_manual],
  three_prime_down[keep_rows_manual],
  activeChromHMM[chromhmm_in_vicinity]
)
rtracklayer::export(
  aggregateOver,
  "processed_data/aggregateOver.bed"
)
```
